question.text: Consider the following salts: $\mathrm{NaCl}, \mathrm{HgCl}_{2}, \mathrm{Hg}_{2} \mathrm{Cl}_{2}, \mathrm{CuCl}_{2}, \mathrm{CuCl}$ and $\mathrm{AgCl}$. Identify the correct set of insoluble salts in water.

solution.text: Salts such as $\mathrm{NaCl}, \mathrm{HgCl}_{2}, \mathrm{CuCl}_{2}$ are soluble in water while salts such as $\mathrm{Hg}_{2} \mathrm{Cl}_{2}, \mathrm{CuCl}$ and $\mathrm{AgCl}$ are insoluble in water.
